event.title: EV Battery Cybersecurity
event.subtitle: SIM-006: Detection Rule Simulator
event.description:
SIM-006 is the decision layer of the Battery Cybersecurity Platform. It takes one battery
event (telemetry, identity, firmware or cyber), checks it against 8 detection rules, and returns PASS,
WARN or HARD_FAIL for each rule plus one overall gate. Other simulators produce data; SIM-006
decides whether that data can be trusted.
